steps.title: Set inclusion and exclusion criteria
steps.instruction: Include participants aged 20‑60 years with BMI ≤30 kg/m², who slept ≥6 h the night before, have no insomnia, Epworth Sleepiness Score ≤10/24, no known pupillary afferent or efferent lesions, consumed ≤3 glasses of alcohol the previous evening, and have not taken caffeine, nicotine, benzodiazepines or stimulants on the morning of assessment; exclude anyone violating any of these conditions.

steps.title: Assign IDs and record baseline data
steps.instruction: Give each participant a unique anonymous ID and record: age (years), sex (0 = male, 1 = female), height (cm), weight (kg), mean work‑day sleep duration (h), sleep duration night before assessment (h), sleep‑deprivation status (<6 h = 1, ≥6 h = 0), insomnia report (1 = yes, 0 = no), ESS total score, excessive daytime sleepiness (ESS > 10 →1, else 0), prior eye disease (1 = yes, 0 = no), alcohol consumption >3 glasses previous evening (1 = yes, 0 = no), and intake of alcohol/caffeine/nicotine/stimulants on assessment morning (1 = yes, 0 = no). Use 99 for any missing data.

steps.title: Randomise intervention order
steps.instruction: For each participant, perform a coin toss to decide which condition will be administered first: struck singing bowl (code 0) or silent singing bowl (code 1). The opposite condition will be given at the second visit. Record the assigned condition code.

steps.title: Schedule first assessment
steps.instruction: Book the participant for the first experimental session one week after enrolment, ensuring the visit occurs within the same daily time window (between 11:00 and 18:00) as the second session.

steps.title: Execute struck singing bowl protocol
steps.instruction: If the participant’s first condition is ‘struck’, have them lie on a hammock positioned over the singing bowl. Strike the bowl seven times, maintaining a 30‑second interval between strikes. After the seventh strike, keep the participant lying over the bowl for a further 20 minutes of relaxation.

steps.title: Execute silent singing bowl protocol
steps.instruction: If the participant’s first condition is ‘silent’, have them lie on the same hammock over the bowl for a continuous 20‑minute period without any bowl striking.

steps.title: Collect sleepiness and pupillary data
steps.instruction: Immediately before the 20‑minute relaxation period, record the Karolinska Sleepiness Scale (KSS) score and the pupillary unrest index (PUI) in mm/min. After the 20‑minute period, record KSS again; for struck sessions also record PUI after, and for silent sessions record PUI after (the protocol lists KSS after twice, but capture it once).

steps.title: Conduct second session with opposite condition
steps.instruction: One week after the first session, repeat steps 5‑7 using the condition not previously administered, keeping the same time‑of‑day window (11:00–18:00). Record all measurements as before.
